newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs to struggle over 132.80.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs to struggle over 132.80.

text.p: September BTPs face fresh resistance at 132.80 on Tuesday after the contract pierced its all time high in early trade, technical analysts said.
But any gains above there will likely be capped by the psychological barrier at 133.00, they added.

"We could see 132.80, a Fibonacci projection, if we get another push higher in BTPs," said one trader at an Italian bank in London. "There's also going to be some narrowing of spreads after the good news from Amsterdam yesterday."
By 0740 GMT, September BTPs were up 34 basis points at 132.53, off an earlier new all time high at 132.62.
The trader put good support at 132.20, then 132.00.
David Wood, an independent technical analyst near London, said BTPs faced immediate resistance at 132.60, then 133.00.
He also noted that September Eurolira was trying to get through the 93.46 level. "If we were to get through there it would be quite bullish for the Italian market," he said.
By 0747 GMT, September Eurolira was up four basis points at 93.41. The market hit a daily high of 93.46 on June 12 and 13.
Wood said there was a fairly solid band of support for BTPs between 131.90 and 132.00, a series of recent highs and lows.
"If we break below there it would put a bit of top in place in the very short term and would give a target around 131.50," said Wood.
"But the really significant support in the longer term is at 131.10, then 130.90 which was a big top on the way up."
But Wood said while the contract was in the 132 handle, it would keep plugging away around the record levels. "It will get an impetus from the Eurolira too if it can get through 93.46," he added.
